template.name: Mindray Sidestream CO2 Module
template.desc: Sidestream CO2 module (plugs into the monitor): visual, electrical safety, leak test and CO2 accuracy. From the CHS Ansur template “Side Stream CO2 module AS-NZS 3551 PVT”. Electrical safety to AS/NZS 3551:2012+A2 with the module fitted in its monitor, as the Ansur template runs it: PE 0.2 ohm; insulation mains–PE and mains–applied parts over 1 Mohm (Ansur set no limit on mains–applied parts; 1 Mohm as on the CO2 + O2 module), applied parts–PE recorded; enclosure 100/500/500 µA; earth leakage 5000/10000 µA (B11.6; the Ansur template listed both 500/1000 and 5000/10000); applied part CO2 type BF (patient leakage 100/500 µA, mains on applied parts 5000 µA, normal polarity). Needs the ESA612.

steps.title: Visual inspection
steps.instructions: Inspect the module, its cables and its connectors. Do not open the module.

items: The case, display screen, buttons, power cord, and accessories have no obvious signs of damage.
The external connecting cables are not frayed and the connector pins are not loose or bent.
The external connectors are not loose and their pins are not bent.
The safety labels and data plate are clearly legible.
The power-on test is passed. The power indicator and alarm system works correctly and the monitor starts up properly.

steps.title: Mains voltage
steps.instructions:
Set up for the electrical safety tests:
1. Plug the ESA612 into the mains supply.
2. Fit the sidestream CO2 module in a monitor (or its module rack). Connect the monitor’s power cord to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the monitor on.
3. Fit the watertrap and sampling line as they are used.

steps.title: Protective earth resistance
steps.instructions: Connect the monitor’s power cord to the ESA612 equipment outlet. Clip the red test lead to an exposed earthed metal part, such as a rear-panel screw.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to protective earth
steps.instructions: Connect the monitor’s power cord to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the monitor on. Don’t touch the monitor or module during the test.

steps.title: Insulation: applied parts to protective earth
steps.instructions: Connect the monitor’s power cord to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the monitor on. Don’t touch the monitor or module during the test. Recorded only: the Ansur template sets no limit.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to applied parts
steps.instructions: Connect the monitor’s power cord to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the monitor on. Don’t touch the monitor or module during the test. Must be over 1 Mohm (AS/NZS 3551 B9.3), as on the CO2 + O2 module; the Ansur template sets no limit.

steps.title: Enclosure leakage
steps.instructions:
Connect the red test lead to a conductive non-earthed exposed part of the module or monitor.
Note: only a representative sample of conductive non-earthed exposed parts needs to be tested.

steps.title: Earth leakage
steps.instructions: Connect the monitor’s power cord to the ESA612 equipment outlet. The monitor will be switched on and off between conditions. Limits: 5000 µA normal, 10000 µA neutral open (AS/NZS 3551:2012+A2 B11.6).

steps.title: Patient leakage
steps.instructions: Connect the module’s applied part (CO2) to the ESA612 RA post. Connect the monitor’s power cord to the ESA612 equipment outlet.

steps.title: Mains on applied parts
steps.instructions: Connect the module’s applied part (CO2) to the ESA612 RA post. Connect the monitor’s power cord to the ESA612 equipment outlet. Normal polarity, as in the Ansur template.

items: CO2 Leak Test: Block the gas inlet of the module or watertrap. The sidestream CO2 flowrate is slower than 10ml/min and an alarm of CO2 Filterline Err is given. It indicates that there is no leakage.

readings.label: CO2 Accuracy Test: The displayed CO2 value is within 6.0±0.3%.
